description: This file defines the Banner controller class within the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing banner modules in the admin interface. It contains methods for displaying, saving, adding, and deleting banner modules, and interacts with models and views related to banners and modules.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for managing banner modules in the OpenCart admin panel, providing CRUD operations and interfacing with models and views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the banner module configuration page, initializing form data with existing module info if available.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving banner module configurations, either creating or updating a module based on submitted data, with validation and permissions check.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new banner module with the default title, after checking modification permissions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified banner module, assuming the user has the necessary permissions.
